title: The Thorn of the Ninefold Court
author: Tamsin Quintana
blurb: Casper Whitlock, a thief who steals memories, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
